fields: h, intro, items [{t, d, link}]. A link makes the step's name the link. The knot's stage per step runs from tied (first) to straight (the step whose text says the water is back, else the last).
best_for: FaultKnot sets "when something goes wrong" as an editorial split: a huge light title running across a navy and limestone ground, a knotted twin-wall pipe that loosens step by step, and the fault steps read across the foot with the call step on the navy.
